title: DeepSeek Harness
intro: DeepSeek's own harness in its headless profile with JSON events, on DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Sessions resume by id; the reasoning effort maps onto the DeepSeek route's levels.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek, two turns

notes: The provider is DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint (api: anthropic-messages); the patch sets the llm-deepseek row's baseURL to the gateway and its key to the session token.
DSH_PERMISSION_MODE is danger-full-access inside the platform's sandbox; session-log upload to DeepSeek is disabled by the patch.
Text and thinking arrive per committed block, not per token.
